empty_status_shard_contract: pending and delisted may be empty only with a matching direct-provider raw receipt; listed must be nonempty
stock_identity_admission: six ASCII digit symbol with identical ts_code symbol and SH/SZ/BJ suffix; rejected provider rows are receipt-accounted and never rewritten

rollback_contract.before_apply: keep the previously healthy service and database state
rollback_contract.after_apply_starts: never restart an incompatible legacy release; keep the service stopped on failure
rollback_contract.after_verified_publication: only a retained healthy compatible stock catalog data_version is eligible
